**Missing keyword:** Docker. Add it only if you have relevant experience.

- Built a React dashboard using JavaScript.
- Developed a JavaScript dashboard with React and managed source code using Git.
- Created a React dashboard, using Git to track changes throughout development.

The last two assume you used Git on this project; confirm that before using them.
